football_evidence.question: Can Notre Dame contain BYU’s explosive runs?

The measured football evidence leans toward Notre Dame, not toward EdgeDesk’s number. There is a specific reason to suspect EdgeDesk’s inputs: EdgeDesk’s published number sits 9.7 points from the middle of its own other models. Treat the gap as an open research question, not as an edge.
